rationale: This change normalizes owner donor-registration commands and deterministically reorders the development-only donor-intake queue so still-open pre-#679 intake PRs are handled before later requests, with workload/PR-number ordering inside that priority backlog. It does not alter FA3 application/runtime behavior, provider admission, hardware placement, security boundaries, model routing, capability execution, Current Host qualification logic, or the fixed 175-capability baseline; therefore no physical Current Host requalification is required.
